description: Nucleoid routes incoming messages by trust and kind with first-match alternatives
code:
def mailbox(kind, trusted):
    if kind == "blocked":
        return "quarantine"
    elif trusted:
        return "primary"
    else kind == "notice":
        return "updates"
    else:
        return "review"
kind = "notice"
trusted = false
destination = mailbox(kind, trusted)
assert(destination, "updates")
trusted = true
assert(destination, "primary")
kind = "blocked"
assert(destination, "quarantine")
trusted = false
kind = "question"
assert(destination, "review")

description: Nucleoid assigns independent moderation lanes with top-level direct else and elif rules
code:
class Submission
first = Submission()
first.state = "open"
first.flagged = false
second = Submission()
second.state = "open"
second.flagged = true
if $Submission.state == "closed":
    $Submission.lane = "archive"
else $Submission.flagged:
    $Submission.lane = "moderator"
elif $Submission.state == "open":
    $Submission.lane = "community"
else:
    $Submission.lane = "pending"
assert(first.lane, "community")
assert(second.lane, "moderator")
first.flagged = true
assert(first.lane, "moderator")
second.state = "closed"
assert(second.lane, "archive")
first.state = "draft"
first.flagged = false
assert(first.lane, "pending")

description: Nucleoid keeps a saved incident classifier definition separate from live severity inputs
Nucleoid classifies request tags through balanced slice and object-literal conditions
code:
def handler(method, tags):
    if method == "DELETE":
        return "audit"
    elif tags[:1] == ["private"] and ({allowed: true}).allowed:
        return "authenticated"
    else method == "GET":
        return "cache"
    else:
        return "origin"
method = "GET"
tags = ["public", "small"]
selected = handler(method, tags)
assert(selected, "cache")
tags = ["private", "small"]
assert(selected, "authenticated")
method = "DELETE"
assert(selected, "audit")
method = "POST"
tags = ["public"]
assert(selected, "origin")
assert(tags, ["public"])
